// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// expressions / macros / decorators expansion materialization and serde
newtype route = (string,);
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds

@route("/users")
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
function users(): string {
    return "users";
}

const declaration = comptime eval<Declaration>(ds`
//                  ^^^^^^^^ keyword.other.comptime.ds
    type RouteDefinition = { path: string; handler: unknown };
`);
